review_notes: I read the whole file and the relevant parts of FiniteIntersections.lean (isUnit_intersectionSubring_iff, mem_contractedIdeal_iff, and the localization proof around line 520). I found no repeated machinery that meets the rubric. The repeated pieces are short order-theoretic steps and thin wrappers over existing API. The nonemptiness argument is by_contra plus the field characterization, used in two places, and it is already factored as the private lemma nonempty_of_isPrime_ne_bot. The inline by_contra in isMaximal_iff_eq_bot_or_contractedIdeal is a two-line case split on a different hypothesis. I did not run Lean, so I make no claim about whether any rewrite compiles.

claims.reason: The shared content is a one-line order step: `le_antisymm (mem_intersectionSubring_iff … x.property i) (le_of_not_gt _)`, which turns `v ≤ 1` and `¬ v < 1` into `v = 1`. It sits inside an application of the existing iff `isUnit_intersectionSubring_iff`. The proof of the proposed lemma would be exactly that anonymous-constructor expression. The lemma would therefore be a thin wrapper around existing API, which the rubric excludes. The two uses also take different inputs. The first (lines 73–76) has `hnot i : x ∉ contractedIdeal val i` directly. The second (lines 145–151) has only `htriv`, so every place needs a derived `x ∉ contractedIdeal` fact. That is extra translation through `mem_contractedIdeal_iff` and `isNontrivial_iff_exists_lt_one`. The proposed Use 2 is not shorter or clearer than the current four lines. The third occurrence (FiniteIntersections.lean:522–526) proves `val i s = 1` for a localization denominator. It does not prove IsUnit, so the proposed lemma does not apply to it. The same `le_antisymm … le_of_not_gt` idiom also appears at line 122 of FiniteIntersections.lean, again as a short order step. The change would save only a few lines and add a lemma, which does not meet the nontrivial-reasoning bar.

evidence.excerpt:
have hunit : IsUnit x := (isUnit_intersectionSubring_iff val x).mpr
      ⟨hx0, fun i => le_antisymm
        ((mem_intersectionSubring_iff val _).mp x.property i)
        (le_of_not_gt (fun hlt => hnot i ((mem_contractedIdeal_iff val i x).mpr hlt)))⟩

refine ⟨hx0, fun i => le_antisymm
      ((mem_intersectionSubring_iff val _).mp x.property i) ?_⟩
    apply le_of_not_gt
    intro hlt
    exact htriv i ((val i).isNontrivial_iff_exists_lt_one.mpr ⟨x, hx0, hlt⟩)

have hnot : ¬val i (s : K) < 1 := by
      simpa only [Ideal.mem_primeCompl_iff, mem_contractedIdeal_iff] using s.property
    exact le_antisymm hle (le_of_not_gt hnot)
